description: SEC fails-to-deliver of a US stock ($0.01): daily failed deliveries up to 120 days, value, share of shares outstanding and the Reg SHO threshold pattern (THRESHOLD_LIKE = hard to borrow, squeeze risk). Omit symbol for the largest fails on the latest settlement date.

days.description: Number of days to cover (look-back; days ahead for calendars)

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. GME; omit for the market-wide top list

name: get_fails_to_deliver
